cards.name: Anti-Personnel Pod
cards.text: This gear may be used with this unit's other non-Anti-Personnel Pods defense special equipment. (optional) If the only opposing figures this unit is in base contact with are infantry, this unit does not need to make any break away rolls when it is given a move order, even if one or more of those opposing figures has Grapple. Any infantry in base contact with this unit when this unit breaks away is dealt only 1 pushing damage.

cards.name: R.I.S.C. Queen Bee Ammo
cards.text: If this unit succeeds at a ranged combat attack against a single target opposing figure, all figures friendly to this unit ignore all ranged combat requirements except minimum and maximum range when making ballistic range type ranged combat attacks against the target this turn. Opposing figures targeting this unit with ballistic range type ranged combat attacks ignore all ranged combat requirements except minimum and maximum range.

cards.name: R.I.S.C. Fire Shot
cards.text: (optional) When this unit makes a successful ranged combat attack against a single opposing target Mech, the target and all Mechs whose center dots are within 6 inches of the target's center dot gain 1 heat (in addition to any other heat generated by the attack). Before making the attack roll for the attack, roll one six-sided die. On a result of 1 or 2, this gear is ignored. Also on a result of 1, eliminate this gear and this unit gains 2 heat in addition to any other heat generated by the attack.

cards.name: R.I.S.C. Seismic Dampener
cards.text: At the beginning of each order stage of the opponent to your immediate left, roll one six-sided die. On a result of 1 or 2, this gear is ignored. Also on a result of 1, eliminate this gear. (optional) This gear may be used with this unit's other non-R.I.S.C Seismic Dampener defense special equipment. Indirect-fire ranged combat attacks cannot be made against this unit, and it ignores other units Streak Missiles special equipment. If a line of fire drawn to this unit crosses hindering terrain, the line of fire is blocked.

cards.name: R.I.S.C. Hot-Drop Shielding
cards.text: Deploy this unit at the beginning of the command phase of your second turn, anywhere on the battlefield except in base contact with an opposing figure or in an opponent's deployment zone. After this unit is deployed, roll one six-sided die. On a result of 1 or 2, turn this unit's heat dial until three radioactive symbols show and give the unit two order tokens. Also on a result of 1, deal this unit impact damage equal to one-half its primary damage value.

cards.name: Colleen Sawyer
cards.text: YOU AND YOU AND . . . (optional) When this unit makes a close combat attack, all opposing infantry and vehicles in base contact with its front arc become targets. Make one attack roll and compare the attack roll result to each target's defense value. Score damage equal to this unit's primary damage value to each target against which the attack succeeds.

cards.name: James Carrott
cards.text: NICE TRY At the beginning of your command stage, choose a single opposing target Mech that this unit can draw a clear line of fire to; ignore this unit's maximum range value. Cancel the ability of any pilot assigned to the target until the beginning of your next command stage.

cards.name: 'One Eyed' Jack Farrell
cards.text: ONE EYED If this pilot is assigned to its preferred Mech, the Mech gets +2 to its attack value. If assigned to any other Mech, the Mech gets +1 to its attack value instead. BRUTE FORCE When this unit succeeds at a close combat attack using its primary damage value, damage scored is impact damage.

cards.name: Alyssa Johns
cards.text: LIKE A ROCK (optional) This unit's Hardened Armor and Heavy Armor reduce impact damage and damage from special attacks.

cards.name: Kurt Tanner
cards.text: LIKE A SHADOW (optional) When an opposing figure breaks away from this unit, and there are no other opposing figures in base contact with this unit, place this unit in base contact with the front arc of the opposing figure that broke away after its movement ends. If you do, this unit gains 1 heat.

cards.name: Lena Brice
cards.text: BOB AND WEAVE (optional) When this unit is not shut down, decrease by 1 any nonpushing damage dealt to it; it gains 1 heat.
